retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, moody portrait featuring a central subject with long blonde hair intertwined with heavy industrial chains against a dark, atmospheric backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a woman with long, textured blonde hair that partially obscures her face. She is draped in heavy, dark metal chains that contrast with her pale skin and light hair. The background is a deep, smoky blue with dark, indistinct sculptural elements, creating a sense of confinement and ethereal mystery.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between soft skin/hair and hard industrial chains
Subject centered against a dark, receding background
Cool blue background tones versus warm skin highlights
Vertical lines of hair echoing the diagonal path of the chains
coreInvariants: Heavy dark metal chains as a primary prop
Long, textured blonde hair as a central framing element
Deep blue and black atmospheric background
Soft, direct studio lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the central part of the face serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the chain from the shoulder down across the chest, framed by the verticality of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured negative space surrounds the subject, concentrated in the upper corners and background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value contrast on the subject's face and hair.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant warm colors like red or orange
Limit palette to cool blues, greys, and desaturated skin tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic portrait of a woman with long blonde hair and pale skin, draped in heavy dark chains, set against a dark blue smoky studio background with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out serif font in white or silver, positioned in the lower third or upper center to maintain focus on the face.

verificationChecks: Ensure chains appear heavy and metallic
Check that hair texture is detailed and slightly messy
Verify the background remains dark and atmospheric
Confirm lighting is focused on the subject's face

adjustableVariables: Thickness and rust level of the chains
Length and styling of the hair
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on chains
Modern clothing items that break the fantasy theme
postGenerationChecks: Do the chains have a realistic weight and texture?
Is the color palette dominated by cool blues and pale tones?
Is the lighting soft yet high-contrast?
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + [Material Contrast: Soft Hair vs Hard Metal] + [Atmospheric Background: Dark Blue Smoke] + [Lighting: Soft Frontal Studio Light]
